svg.title: Demand shifts right from D0 to D1; price and quantity rise
svg.desc: S through (30, N$10), (60, N$20), (90, N$30); D0 through (90, N$10), (60, N$20), (30, N$30); D1 through (120, N$10), (90, N$20), (60, N$30), to the right of D0 by 30 at every price. E0 at N$20 and 60 packets; E1 at N$25 and 75 packets, both projected to the axes.
svg.text: D0 to D1: 30 more packets demanded at every price
Price rises N$20 to N$25; quantity 60 to 75
Demand shifts right; supply does not move.
